title: Crux Yard
brief: Website for Crux Yard, a bouldering gym in a converted tram depot in Leeds. 300 problems reset every week across six walls, a training area with a campus board and kilter board, a cafe serving coffee and toasties, and kids' sessions on weekend mornings. First-timers do a 15-minute induction, shoe hire available. Prices: day pass, 10-visit pass, monthly membership (exact prices to confirm). Open late every day; exact opening hours to confirm. The vibe: loud, chalky, friendly, not elitist. Main goal: book a first visit / induction. There is no online booking system connected yet, so the booking action should explain how to book (at the desk or by phone, number to add) instead of pretending a slot was reserved. No member testimonials or invented staff bios: we haven't collected any yet.
